'''Quell''' was the principal [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of the [[Quell system/Legends|Quell system]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a [[Sky Battle of Quell|battle]] was fought between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] in the upper [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] of the planet.

==Description==
Quell was the principal planet of the [[Quell system/Legends|star system]] that bore its name<ref name="DB" /> and one of many remote worlds<ref name="CWEGS1-2" /> located in the far reaches<ref name="DB" /> of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="TCW" /> Quell lay along the [[Salin Corridor/Legends|Salin Corridor]], the largest [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperspace route]] that crossed the entire [[Trans-Hydian/Legends|Trans-Hydian]] region.<ref name="TEA" />

Quell was a terrestrial planet<ref name="CWEGS1-2" /> that, from [[Realspace/Legends|realspace]], appeared as a cerulean sphere<ref name="EGJC">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode013.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Jedi Crash}}</ref> shrouded in thick [[Cloud/Legends|cloud]] masses. During the final century of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], Quell was home to members of various [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="CWEGS1-2" />

==History==
[[File:Epguide013.png|left|thumb|280px|Sky battle over Quell]]
In the early stages<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Quell was located in the contested Outer Rim Territories<ref name="TCW" /> and had the misfortune of becoming a battleground between [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] and [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] forces<ref name="CWEGS1-2" />, who clashed high in the rarified [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] of the planet.<ref name="EGJC" /> While on a mission to Quell,<ref name="FF-2014 36: Bly">{{FactFile2014|36|BLY 1-4|Bly}}</ref> [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]] and her [[Flotilla/Legends|flotilla]] of three [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyers]] were [[Sky Battle of Quell|ambushed]] in the planet's upper atmosphere by a [[Confederate Navy/Legends|Confederate Navy]] [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]]<ref name="TCW" /> of seven [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|''Munificent''-class star frigates]].<ref name="CWA: Starfighter">{{TCWA|Starfighter}}</ref> The battle did not end well for the Republic and resulted in a Separatist victory.<ref name="Planets in Peril">''[[The Clone Wars: Planets in Peril]]''</ref>

Decades after the Clone Wars, Quell once again became a battlefield. Between [[12 ABY/Legends|12]] and [[13 ABY/Legends|13 ABY]], the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Battle of Quell (Galactic Civil War)|attacked]] the forces of the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] in the contested Trans-Hydian territories, which had previously been controlled by various [[Warlord/Legends|Imperial warlords]]. The Republic and Imperial forces clashed on Quell, and the Republic emerged victorious.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|The direction was to make it [the battle] the upper stratosphere, almost in between space and the atmosphere, with only clouds far below.|[[Matt Gaser]]|<ref name="ASW">''[[The Art of Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Lego-Quell.jpg|right|thumb|250px|The planet Quell in the video game ''[[LEGO Star Wars III: The Clone Wars]]'']]
The planet Quell was featured as the opening act of "[[Jedi Crash]]," the thirteenth episode in the [[2009]] ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series' [[The Clone Wars: Season One|first season]].<ref name="TCW" /> In a publication on the official website [[StarWars.com]], it was stated that the script had originally described the battle over Quell as taking place in space, but it was shifted to the upper atmosphere for dramatic effect as the show entered preproduction. Naturally, such a change in altitude created all sorts of problems for a [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]], according to the established lore on how such devices functioned near planets.<ref name="EGJC" />

Quell's surface has only appeared in the non-canon [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[LEGO Star Wars III: The Clone Wars]]''. Unlike its seemingly habitable conditions, the planet’s landscape consisted of lifeless gray rocky mountains and appeared bleak.<ref name="LESW">''[[LEGO Star Wars III: The Clone Wars]]''</ref>
